title: VLA / world model documentation review
objective: Read only the four root-level VLA / world model / architecture documents and produce a structured summary of how VLA, world model, robot execution, logging, and evaluation relate in the current project.
context: task_0001 showed that VLA/world-model intent currently lives mainly in root planning documents, not in identified source modules. Before designing any model or evaluation task, AI-A needs a static, read-only synthesis of these documents so that data flow, model flow, evaluation metrics, and a concrete engineering-ready next step (task_0003) can be defined. This task must remain documentation-only: no source code changes, no robot motion, no ROS/driver/controller launch, and no secret/dataset/checkpoint/rosbag access.
steps: Validate this task with .ai_agents/scripts/agent_guard.py before doing anything else.

Read only these four root documents using static read commands: G2_GDK_SECONDARY_DEVELOPMENT_VLA_WORLDMODEL_GUIDE.md, G2_LIVE_ARCHITECTURE_DEEP_DIVE_20260618.md, G2_WEEKLY_REPORT_20260618.md, G2_WEEKLY_REPORT_BRIEF_20260618.md.
Do not open, read, or execute any other file; do not run any robot, ROS, driver, controller, or motion script; do not read secrets, datasets, checkpoints, or rosbags.
From the documents, summarize the current VLA / world model objective in plain language.
Extract the data flow and name the concrete signals: camera, logs, state, action, task.
Extract the model flow and name the components: VLA, world model, critic, memory, planner, controller.
Extract candidate evaluation metrics that could realistically be measured from existing logs/artifacts.
Propose the single most engineering-ready next task (task_0003) with a one-line rationale, keeping it low-risk and documentation/analysis-only.
Write the final result JSON to .ai_agents/tasks/results/result_0002_vla_worldmodel_doc_review.json.
Do not modify any source code.
success_criteria: Only the two declared output files are created; no source code is modified.
No robot motion script, ROS driver, or controller is executed.
The review summarizes the current VLA / world model objective.
The review extracts the data flow: camera/logs/state/action/task.
The review extracts the model flow: VLA/world model/critic/memory/planner/controller.
The review extracts candidate evaluation metrics that can realistically be measured.
The review proposes the next most engineering-ready task_0003 with a short rationale.
stop_conditions: Any command attempts to launch a robot, ROS, controller, or motion script.
Any command attempts to modify source code.
Any command attempts to read secrets, datasets, checkpoints, or rosbags.
A command requires sudo or installs system packages.
A command attempts to read any file other than the four listed root documents.
A command attempts to start ROS drivers, hardware controllers, or actuator commands.
